title: Quick Accent doesn't work with accents keys on Italian keyboard anymore

judgment.rationale: The maintainer explained that Quick Accent is intended to activate on base, non-accented letters; the author then asked to add accented Italian keys as a feature. The report does not establish a regression, and the existing request for current-version confirmation was answered in 2024. The remaining ask is an enhancement request, not a demonstrated defect.
evidence: The report originated on 0.67.1 with Italian-layout accented keys such as è and à.
A maintainer stated that Quick Accent is intended to work on base (non-accented) letters: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/23967#issuecomment-1422439082.

The author later said they were unsure whether the accented-key behavior had worked before and asked whether it could be added as a feature: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/23967#issuecomment-1430787069.
The maintainer requested a current-version check; the author replied in 2024 that the behavior remained unchanged, but that does not distinguish a regression from the intended limitation.
judgment.recommended_action: Retain as a feature request for prioritization; do not propose a bug fix or repeat the old version-check request.

fix_assessment.rationale: The confirmed product behavior is described as intentional. Supporting already-accented physical keys would be a separate feature design and prioritization decision, not a defect fix.

issue_context.summary: The author wants Quick Accent to activate on pre-accented keys in an Italian layout to produce uppercase accented letters; maintainers describe the current base-letter-only behavior as intended.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.67.1 and Italian layout keys such as è and à.
The author described using Shift+è+Space to select È/É, then expressed uncertainty about whether that had worked before.
A maintainer said Quick Accent is intended for base letters, not accented keys.
The author confirmed unchanged behavior on 0.74.1 in response to a /needinfo request and later tried a newer version; no later comments exist.
inferences: The current evidence supports an enhancement request, not an actionable regression fix.
The author’s request is to generate uppercase accented characters through Quick Accent; no specific implementation or acceptance criteria are supplied.
issue_context.analysis: Do not repeat the request for a version check or ask for logs. The issue should remain in the feature-prioritization queue unless product scope changes or the author supplies evidence of a true regression.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live body and all seven comments, including the original /needinfo exchange and maintainer explanation.
Checked the Quick Accent module ownership; no code path can be identified as defective given the explicit intended-behavior response.
